name: MurkPyRSS
short_desc: RSS generator with custom extractors and AI
author: Rodrigo Mescua
description: MurkPyRSS generates RSS feeds from websites with native, manual, and AI-generated extractors. It includes FlareSolverr support, isolated Docker execution for custom scripts, and FreshRSS integration.

form_fields.label: Show Top extractors
form_fields.hint: Shows native extractors marked as Top in the dashboard.
